case_name: Every member of unlawful assembly guilty of offence committed in prosecution of common object
issues: If an offence is committed by any member of an unlawful assembly...
court_reasoning: Every person who, at the time of the committing of that offence, is a member of the same assembly, is guilty of that offence.
holding: every person who, at the time of the committing of that offence, is a member of the same assembly, is guilty of that offence.
